idea-plugin.name: Line Numbers
idea-plugin.description:
Line Numbers display relative line numbers in your editor gutter, making navigation faster and more intuitive. Perfect for developers who prefer line numbers that adapt to their current cursor position.

Key Features

  • Relative Numbering: Shows the distance from your current line
  • Clean Interface: Optionally hide the IDE's default absolute line numbers
  • Smart Navigation: Quick jumps with distance-based mental math
  • Instant Toggle: Turn relative numbering on or off with a keyboard shortcut
  • Current Line Highlight: Clearly highlights the line where your cursor is located

How It Works

Lines show their distance from your caret position:

             2 | code
             1 | code
            20 | code <- current line (highlighted, shows actual line number)
             1 | code
             2 | code

Configuration

Settings → Editor → Line Numbers

  • Enable/disable the feature
  • Option to hide built-in line numbers for a cleaner look

Keyboard Shortcuts

  • Windows/Linux: Ctrl + Alt + N
  • macOS: ⌘ + ⌥ + N (Cmd + Option + N)

Why Flexible Numbers?

Relative line numbers help you navigate code faster by showing exactly how many lines to move up or down, rather than forcing you to calculate distances from absolute line numbers. Popular among Vim users and developers working with large codebases.
